description.value: Capones Italian Kitchen is a seasonal dinner restaurant set within Sun Peaks Resort in BC's Thompson-Okanagan region, offering Italian cuisine alongside a curated selection of BC wines. The restaurant is known for its mountain and village views and caters to both intimate reservations and large group family-style dinners. It operates as a sister property to Cahilty Creek Kitchen & Taproom, also at Sun Peaks.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational dinner restaurant at Sun Peaks Resort with an active 2026 season menu and staff hiring posted; suitable for inclusion as a Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists visiting Sun Peaks.
